hero.headline: Dinchen Lepcha
hero.subhead: The version of this site with fewer spreadsheets and more of what I actually care about outside work.

cards.title: I Build Things Nobody Asked For
cards.blurb: This entire website is an example. Nobody asked for a Netflix-style portfolio. I made one anyway.

cards.title: Spreadsheet Person By Day
cards.blurb: MIS reporting and dashboards at Magicpin, automated wherever humanly possible.

cards.title: Car Market Deep Dives
cards.blurb: Entry-level hatchbacks to used BMWs and Porsches — I've researched way more of the Indian second-hand car market than my bank balance has any business allowing. Thats when i realised - I have spreadsheets. I do not have the money.

cards.title: Building Small Tools
cards.blurb: Payroll apps, finance dashboards, automation scripts — if it saves someone time, I want to build it.

cards.title: Weekend Side Projects
cards.blurb: If I'm not working, I'm probably crocheting

cards.title: QuickSlip
cards.blurb: A payroll SaaS idea for small Indian shop owners, built and shipped just to test the concept.

cards.title: Rongsa Farmstay
cards.blurb: Live website for a homestay in Darjeeling, built and deployed end-to-end alongside my day job.
cards.detail: Designed and built a full booking website for Rongsa Farmstay — an authentic Lepcha-hosted homestay in Sittong, Darjeeling. Includes a homepage, rooms & pricing, gallery, and a WhatsApp-based booking flow, deployed live on GitHub Pages.

cards.title: A Different Side of Me
cards.blurb: Want to explore a different world of mine?
cards.detail: Step into a 3D space universe I built from scratch — walk around, explore, and find out more about who I am outside of spreadsheets.
